name: Air, Land, & Sea: Spies, Lies, & Supplies

rounds.endCondition: First to 12 VP wins (18 for a longer game; 6 for Epic or team games)

categories.label: Battles won by theater control (no withdrawal)
categories.labelVi: Trận thắng do kiểm soát chiến trường (không ai rút lui)
categories.hint: 6 VP each: you controlled more Theaters after both players played all cards.

categories.label: VP from opponent's withdrawals
categories.labelVi: Điểm do đối thủ rút lui
categories.hint: Sum of VP read off the withdrawing player's Supreme Commander card (by cards left in their hand); add per battle.

tiebreakers.description: Within a Battle, tied Strength in a Theater goes to the 1st Player; with no cards on either side the 1st Player controls it. Only one player scores per Battle, so a tie on the 12 VP target cannot occur.

winCondition: The first player to reach 12 VP wins. Only one player scores per battle, so both cannot reach 12 together.
notes: family: area-majority (two-player theater control card game, scored per Battle toward a VP target). Winner of each Battle scores 6 VP if neither player withdrew; if a player withdraws, the opponent scores the VP printed on the withdrawing player's Supreme Commander card for cards left in hand (values not legible in the image-only PDF, so entered by scorer). Variants not modelled: Epic mode (5 Theaters, winner controls 3+), 3-4 player team variant (teams total their hands when withdrawing), mixing with Air, Land & Sea. Rulebook v9 is an image-only PDF; read visually (pp. 9-11 of the booklet).

sources.title: ALS: Spies, Lies & Supplies Rulebook v9
sources.section: Ending Battles / Scoring Victory Points (p.9); Winning the Game (p.10); Team Variant scoring & withdrawal (p.11)

endCondition.description: Checked after each Battle; first player to reach 12 VP wins. Optional: 18 VP longer game; 6 VP recommended for Epic mode and 3-4 player team variant.
